articles.headline: Blackstone leads race to acquire Actis-owned energy platform BluPine
articles.summary: Private equity firm Blackstone has emerged as the frontrunner to acquire renewable energy platform BluPine Energy from Actis. The deal is estimated to be valued between $1.7 billion and $1.8 billion. BluPine has an installed non-fossil fuel capacity of 500MW and aims to reach 4GW by 2030. Other contenders including Brookfield and INOX were also reportedly in the fray.

articles.headline: India’s retail inflation hits two-year high of 6.09% in October
articles.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, breaching the RBI's upper tolerance limit of 6% for the first time in two years. The surge was driven by an 8.94% jump in food prices and an unfavorable base effect. Analysts suggest this breach of the target range may compel the central bank to maintain high interest rates and delay potential cuts in the near term.

articles.headline: Audit and advisory firms roll out 10-15% pay hikes
articles.summary: Big Four and mid-tier audit and advisory firms are rolling out salary increments of 10-15% to retain talent. The hikes come as firms prepare for the next round of mandatory audit rotations starting in 2027. Some niche firms are offering even higher increases of 25% for top performers. Firms are also focusing on upskilling employees in artificial intelligence to boost productivity.

articles.headline: SpiceJet struggles with wage delays and mounting supplier dues
articles.summary: SpiceJet is facing a severe liquidity crunch, leading to delays in salary payments for employees and defaults on payments to suppliers and lessors. The airline's domestic market share has fallen to 0.6%, with many aircraft grounded due to legal and financial disputes. Flight operations have seen significant cancellations, and the airline's total unpaid dues are estimated at over ₹700 crore.

articles.headline: Consumer AI startups see surge in venture capital backing
articles.summary: Venture capital firms are increasing investments in Indian consumer AI startups, betting on specialized applications that use local languages. Startups like SuperLiving and Profound.Me have raised millions to develop AI-driven health and productivity tools. Despite high computing costs, investors believe localized, task-specific AI will drive long-term user retention in the price-sensitive market.

articles.headline: CAG to audit power discoms over rising financial stress
articles.summary: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) has launched a nationwide performance audit of power distribution companies (discoms). The audit will focus on financial performance, operational efficiency, and the accuracy of subsidy claims. Discoms are facing increased debt, with accumulated losses reaching ₹3.42 trillion, prompting government concerns over sector sustainability.

articles.headline: India a haven for global investors despite global turmoil: Goyal
articles.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India remains a safe harbor for global investors due to its stable policies and large market. Speaking at the Partnership Summit, he highlighted that India has finalized nine free trade agreements in the last decade. He emphasized that the government is aiming to reach a $30 trillion economy and is focused on improving ease of doing business.

articles.headline: India and Canada trade pact talks may conclude by December
articles.summary: Trade ministers from India and Canada have expressed hope that negotiations for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) could conclude by December. The sixth round of talks is currently underway, focusing on trade in goods, services, and investment. A deal would boost bilateral trade, which has seen some volatility due to diplomatic tensions earlier in the year.

articles.headline: Gulf countries overtake Russia as India's top crude oil source
articles.summary: Oil imports from the Persian Gulf have surpassed those from Russia for the first time since the start of the Ukraine war. Imports from Gulf nations climbed to 2.1 million barrels per day as discounts on Russian crude narrowed. While Russia remains a major supplier, Indian refiners are returning to traditional Middle Eastern partners to ensure a steady and cost-effective energy supply.

articles.headline: Tata Steel targets 10 million tonnes of local iron ore sales
articles.summary: Tata Steel is aiming to increase its domestic iron ore sales to 10 million tonnes this fiscal year, up from 2 million tonnes previously. The company plans to monetize its surplus mining capacity while ensuring enough supply for its own steel plants. This move follows regulatory changes that allowed the sale of iron ore from captive mines to help alleviate shortages in the domestic market.

articles.headline: Oil India's quarterly profit more than doubles to ₹2,259 crore
articles.summary: State-owned Oil India reported a standalone net profit of ₹2,259 crore for the September quarter, more than doubling from ₹1,044 crore a year ago. The surge was driven by higher realized prices for crude oil and gas, as well as a weaker rupee. Total income for the quarter rose to ₹5,259 crore, reflecting strong operational performance in its exploration and production segments.

articles.headline: Exide and Amara Raja to monetize $1 billion battery investments
articles.summary: India's leading battery makers, Exide Industries and Amara Raja Energy, are moving to commercialize their billion-dollar investments in lithium-ion technology. Both firms are setting up multi-gigawatt cell manufacturing plants to cater to the growing electric vehicle and energy storage markets. They are currently in the process of getting their cells validated by major global automakers.

articles.headline: India’s tuberculosis deaths fall by 38% since 2015
articles.summary: India has recorded a 38% reduction in tuberculosis (TB) mortality since 2015, according to the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026. This figure outperforms the global decline rate of 33%. The health ministry attributed this success to improved treatment access and a 94% success rate in drug-susceptible cases. Estimated deaths dropped from 480,000 in 2015 to 280,000 in 2025.

articles.headline: RBI may bar PE firms from controlling multiple NBFCs
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is considering new rules to prevent private equity (PE) firms from holding controlling stakes in more than one non-banking financial company (NBFC). The move aims to prevent contagion risks and ensure diversified ownership in the shadow banking sector. Under the proposal, a PE firm's ownership in a second NBFC may be capped at 15% or less.

articles.headline: Airtel chairman expects company to be debt-free by 2029
articles.summary: Bharti Airtel Chairman Sunil Bharti Mittal stated in an interview that the telecom giant aims to be debt-free by 2029. The company expects to generate $14-15 billion in annual Ebitda, providing significant capital for buybacks or dividends. Mittal also highlighted that Airtel is focusing on AI and data centers to drive future growth while navigating a highly competitive telecom landscape.

articles.headline: BCCI plans to expand IPL to 12 teams from 2028
articles.summary: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is exploring plans to expand the Indian Premier League (IPL) to 12 teams starting from the 2028 season. Pune and Vadodara have emerged as leading contenders for the new franchises. Each new team could command a valuation of over $1 billion. The move coincides with a new media rights cycle and aims to further monetize the popular cricket league.

articles.headline: Bharti Chairman Sunil Mittal eyes global expansion in satcom and AI
articles.summary: Marking 50 years of Bharti Enterprises, Chairman Sunil Mittal announced plans to renew global expansion through satellite communications, AI infrastructure, and financial services. The group aims to expand data center capacity to 1 GW by 2030 and has taken a 49% stake in Haier's Indian business. Mittal emphasized a shift toward professional management and sovereign cloud capabilities.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh signs MoUs for ₹9.89 lakh crore at CII summit
articles.summary: Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu announced over 300 MoUs worth ₹9.89 lakh crore at the 31st CII Partnership Summit. Key commitments include $2 billion from Kia India to expand manufacturing and ₹80,000 crore from ReNew Energy. The state government plans to enact a new law to protect investments and ensure policy stability, targeting a 74% conversion rate for proposals.

articles.headline: Vodafone Idea reports widened net loss of ₹5,975 crore in Q2
articles.summary: Telecom operator Vodafone Idea (Vi) posted a consolidated net loss of ₹5,975 crore for the quarter ended September, weighed down by an adverse mark-to-market impact on treasury assets. Despite the loss, ARPU grew 10% annually to ₹198, and 4G/5G subscribers rose to 131 million. The company has placed capex orders worth ₹13,200 crore to expand its network footprint.

articles.headline: Tata Steel targets ₹20,000 crore capital expenditure for current year
articles.summary: Managing Director TV Narendran stated that Tata Steel aims for ₹20,000 crore in capex this fiscal year, with ₹15,000 crore allocated for India. Despite EBITDA pressure from higher input costs and the Gulf conflict, the firm expects better realizations in Q3. Restructuring of Netherlands operations remains pending as grant conditions and capex issues are resolved with regulators.

articles.headline: Temasek to invest ₹2,500 crore in Godrej Capital for minority stake
articles.summary: Temasek Holdings will invest ₹2,500 crore in Godrej Capital, valuing the financial services arm at up to ₹28,000 crore. Godrej Industries will retain roughly 80% ownership following the deal. The investment follows Godrej's announcement of plans to list the subsidiary within the next five years.

articles.headline: India's Russian crude oil import bill hits record $6.4 billion
articles.summary: India paid a record $6.43 billion for Russian crude oil in October 2026 as rising prices and higher freight costs shored up values. According to CREA, Russia's Urals-grade crude rose 13% month-on-month. Imports increased at India's three largest refineries—Vadinar, Jamnagar, and Paradip—partly due to disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz affecting alternate shipping routes.

articles.headline: US mid-term results may delay conclusion of India trade deal
articles.summary: Democratic victories in the US Congress may increase scrutiny of trade policies, potentially delaying the India-US interim trade agreement. New Delhi is seeking clarity on Washington’s investigation into excess industrial capacity before finalising tariff commitments. Concerns remain over potential punitive duties under the Lindsey Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act.

articles.headline: PM Modi to meet Council of Ministers on November 18
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to meet his full Council of Ministers on November 18 after returning from the India-Asean Summit. The meeting will focus on governance reforms and outreach schemes for women and youth. The session is intended to provide ministers with feedback and guidance on various aspects of government performance.

articles.headline: India overtakes Taiwan as world's fifth-largest stock market
articles.summary: India has reclaimed its position as the world's fifth-largest stock market, with a total market capitalization of $5.4 trillion. The rebound was driven by aggressive buying from foreign portfolio investors (FPIs), who purchased a net ₹65,735 crore in November. This reversal comes as global investors pull capital from semiconductor-heavy markets like Taiwan and South Korea.

articles.headline: India Inc external commercial borrowings double to $37.4 billion
articles.summary: Fundraising through the External Commercial Borrowing (ECB) route more than doubled to $37.44 billion in the first half of FY27. The surge was largely driven by public sector undertakings (PSUs), which accounted for 38% of the total. PSUs took advantage of a concessional forex swap facility provided by the RBI to reduce currency protection costs.

articles.headline: Growth in India's outbound direct investment slows to 9.4%
articles.summary: India’s overseas direct investment (ODI) commitments grew at a slower pace of 9.4% in H1 FY27, reaching $27.01 billion. This moderation follows two years of very strong growth and suggests a recalibration as companies invest more domestically. Singapore remained the top destination for Indian capital, followed by the Netherlands and the US, while GIFT City saw commitments nearly triple.

articles.headline: Indigenous civil aircraft expected to fly within next two years
articles.summary: Union Civil Aviation Minister Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu announced that India’s first fully-indigenously manufactured civil aircraft will take flight within two years. Speaking on aviation connectivity, he noted that India has expanded from 74 airports in 2014 to 166 today. The government is also planning a second phase of the UDAN scheme to build 100 more airports by 2036.

articles.headline: NCT approves ₹69,000 crore mega power transmission project
articles.summary: The National Committee on Transmission (NCT) has approved a ₹68,816 crore project to build 1,150 kV transmission lines. The project will connect renewable energy hubs in Gujarat and Rajasthan to green hydrogen nodes in the eastern region. This will be the highest voltage level in the Indian transmission system, though some experts raised concerns regarding potential low loading.

articles.headline: AI infrastructure build-out boosts revenue for server and cable firms
articles.summary: The expansion of India's data centre economy is significantly increasing revenues for firms like Netweb Technologies, Redington, and Sterlite Technologies. Netweb saw its AI business grow 1,068%, while Redington's technology solutions group grew 91%. Executives noted that the demand for high-performance GPUs and liquid cooling solutions is driving dramatically higher average selling prices.

articles.headline: CAG to include consumer satisfaction in audits of state discoms
articles.summary: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) will conduct integrated audits of 39 state-owned power distribution companies (discoms), incorporating a consumer satisfaction survey for the first time. The survey will cover 10,000 respondents to evaluate electricity service quality. The move aims to assess the actual outcomes of distribution sector reforms from a user standpoint.

articles.headline: Rajnath Singh urges IAF to develop doctrines for electronic warfare
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh told Indian Air Force commanders to prioritize the development of dedicated doctrines for emerging domains like electronic, cyber, and space warfare. He emphasized that future victories would depend on technological sophistication and the element of surprise. He also exhorted the force to prepare for challenges like kamikaze drones and counter-drone operations.

articles.headline: Infosys Science Foundation announces winners of 2026 Infosys Prize
articles.summary: The Infosys Science Foundation named six winners of the Infosys Prize 2026 for their contributions to economics, engineering, humanities, life sciences, mathematical sciences, and physical sciences. Winners include Karthik Sastry and Swarun Kumar. The prize, which shifted focus this year to honor researchers under age 40, includes a gold medal and $100,000.

articles.headline: PM Modi to inaugurate Bengaluru Namma Metro Pink Line section
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate a 7.5-km stretch of Bengaluru’s Pink Line metro, connecting Kalena Agrahara to Tavarekere. He will also launch projects worth ₹15,600 crore, including a Vande Bharat Express and India’s first LED-dome planetarium in Mysuru. The Pink Line project cost has risen to ₹17,346 crore, with the state government funding roughly ₹12,000 crore.

articles.headline: Air India to convert passenger jets into dedicated freighters
articles.summary: Air India plans to grow its cargo business by converting passenger aircraft into dedicated freighters. CEO Tewolde Gebremariam proposed the strategy to increase revenue alongside expanded commercial partnerships with Singapore Airlines. The cargo business has already seen a boost from airspace closures elsewhere, allowing the carrier to carry higher loads to North America.

articles.headline: Akasa Air reports quarterly loss of ₹550 crore in Q1
articles.summary: Akasa Air's net loss widened to approximately ₹550 crore in the first quarter of FY27, up from ₹350 crore a year earlier. The airline cited high fuel costs and a weak rupee as primary headwinds. Despite the loss, the carrier remains confident in its growth strategy, having recently raised ₹450 crore from investors including the Jhunjhunwala and Premji families.

articles.headline: Donald Trump Suggests Tim Cook as Replacement for Jensen Huang
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump stated on Truth Social that former Apple CEO Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang at Nvidia. Trump described Huang as having done a fantastic job but called Cook the only man to take his place, stating, 'A Legend replaces a Legend!' Trump previously treated Huang as a close adviser, including bringing him on a state visit to China.

articles.headline: Chinese AI Firms Rent Overseas Nvidia Capacity Amid Restriction Fears
articles.summary: Chinese AI companies are seeking to rent Nvidia-powered computing capacity outside China, fearing the Jensen Huang scandal could prompt Washington to tighten restrictions. They are specifically concerned about the Remote Access Security Act, a US bill that would regulate cloud-based access to restricted technology. Currently, Chinese firms use remote data centers to access advanced chips.

articles.headline: AI Firms Hire Former Intelligence Operatives to Counter Espionage Threats
articles.summary: Technology firms including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Nvidia are hiring former intelligence officers to protect against corporate espionage. Experts noted a rise in counterintelligence roles to identify threats like trade secret theft or 'honeytraps.' Salaries for these positions range from $200,000 to $500,000 as firms seek to shield vulnerabilities from foreign intelligence targeting.

articles.headline: Tata Sons Rejects Noel Tata’s Demand for Board Meeting Recording
articles.summary: Tata Sons has rebuffed Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata’s request for a recording of the September 17 board meeting where N Chandrasekaran was reappointed. The company stated that recording in-person meetings is not required by law or its articles. The exchange highlights growing friction over governance and transparency after Noel Tata was the sole director to oppose the reappointment.

articles.headline: India Seeks Bids for Largest Strategic Petroleum Reserve in Odisha
articles.summary: The Indian government is seeking private investors to build its largest strategic petroleum reserve in Chandikhol, Odisha. The 4-million-tonne facility is estimated to cost ₹8,571 crore and would increase India's existing storage capacity by 80%. The project aims to mitigate energy supply risks associated with West Asian disruptions and the Strait of Hormuz bottleneck.

articles.headline: Retail Inflation Surges to 6.09 Percent Crossing RBI Tolerance Limit
articles.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October 2026, breaching the Reserve Bank of India’s upper tolerance limit for the first time under the new CPI series. The increase was primarily driven by a spurt in food prices, which reached 8.9% year-on-year. Analysts now expect the RBI to consider a 25 basis-point rate hike in the upcoming December monetary policy meeting.

articles.headline: Bharti Group Open to Raising Eutelsat OneWeb Stake to 30 Percent
articles.summary: Bharti Enterprises chairman Sunil Mittal announced the group is open to increasing its stake in satellite firm Eutelsat OneWeb to 30%. Mittal stated that Bharti Airtel is pursuing one billion global customers and will bet heavily on financial services, AI data centres, and sovereign cloud. He also confirmed he has created a succession charter for the next generation of the 'House of Bharti.'

articles.headline: AI-Led Hiring Slump is Temporary, Says Infosys Cofounder Kris Gopalakrishnan
articles.summary: Infosys cofounder Kris Gopalakrishnan stated that the current tech hiring slowdown is a temporary consequence of the industry transitioning to AI-led offerings. He predicted a sharp increase in demand for AI-skilled talent over the next three to five years. Gopalakrishnan noted that while current headcounts at top IT majors have fallen, the industry will resume growth after the transition.

articles.headline: AIMIM and Azad Samaj Party Form Alliance for UP Elections
articles.summary: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi and Azad Samaj Party president Chandrashekhar Azad have formed the 'Samajik Parivartan Morcha' for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. Owaisi named Azad as the alliance's chief ministerial candidate. The front intends to consolidate Dalit and Muslim votes to stop the BJP from winning a third term. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav welcomed the move.

articles.headline: PM Modi Urges Media to Spotlight Achievements Ahead of 2047
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed journalists at a Diwali Milan, urging the media to highlight India's global successes as the 'India Story.' He emphasized that the country is working toward a 2047 deadline to become a developed nation. Modi stated that the dream of a developed India now has a set date and requires collective effort before the centenary of independence.

articles.headline: Karnataka Minister Krishna Byre Gowda Dropped from PM Metro Event
articles.summary: Karnataka Minister Krishna Byre Gowda expressed disappointment after being removed from the speaker list at PM Modi’s Bengaluru metro event. Gowda claimed the move was a response to his criticism of the Centre’s funding. He stated that the state invests five rupees for every one rupee from the Centre and argued that the current 50:50 funding model does not reflect reality.

articles.headline: Agnipath Scheme Tweaked Following Feedback from Armed Forces
articles.summary: Defense Minister Rajnath Singh stated that changes to the Agnipath scheme, including permanent service routes for all soldiers, were made following feedback from the armed forces. Speaking at the Air Force Commanders Conference, Singh urged officers to maintain operational readiness and technological superiority to ensure adversaries have no time to react.

articles.headline: Religious Groups and RSS Bodies Clash Over Proposed FCRA Bill
articles.summary: Christian organizations and RSS-linked bodies presented conflicting views on the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026. Christian groups argued the bill undermines religious freedom and hampers social services. RSS-linked organizations supported the proposal, calling it a necessary step to regulate foreign funding and ensure national security.

articles.headline: IIT Kharagpur to Launch Postgraduate Medical Degree Courses
articles.summary: IIT Kharagpur has become the first IIT to receive National Medical Commission accreditation for postgraduate medical degree programs. Starting in the 2026-27 academic session, the institute will offer MD courses at the Dr BC Roy Multi-Speciality Medical Research Centre. The initiative aims to integrate clinical excellence with engineering to shape the future of medical education.

articles.headline: Ladakh Protesters Demand Statehood and Constitutional Safeguards in Leh
articles.summary: Led by the Apex Body Leh, citizens in Ladakh launched protests for statehood and constitutional safeguards. Activist Sonam Wangchuk was reportedly removed from the protest site and directed to stay home. Protesters are also calling for the deferment of local council elections, demanding a result-oriented dialogue process with the Home Ministry to address regional aspirations.

articles.headline: Indian Navy Conducts Biennial Coastal Defense Exercise Sea Vigil-26
articles.summary: The Indian Navy has launched the fifth edition of 'Sea Vigil-26', a pan-India coastal defense exercise. The operation covers the entire coastline and Exclusive Economic Zone to evaluate security preparedness and coordination among maritime stakeholders. The exercise involves a readiness evaluation phase followed by a sea phase on November 18 and 19.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu Rejects Karnataka’s Proposal to Build Mekedatu Dam
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu Minister N Anand rejected Karnataka Deputy CM DK Shivakumar’s assertion that Karnataka can build the Mekedatu dam without permission. Anand stated the project will not be permitted, refuting claims that the Supreme Court had granted unconditional approval. The dispute centers on water storage and rights regarding the interstate Cauvery river.

articles.headline: Akali Dal Waris Punjab De Alleges Delay in Party Registration
articles.summary: The political group Akali Dal Waris Punjab De has urged the Election Commission of India to expedite its registration. The group alleged that its application under the Representation of the People Act has been pending since January 2025, claiming there is an undue delay in processing the request.

articles.headline: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy Appears in Court for 2021 Case
articles.summary: Telangana Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy appeared before a local court in Hyderabad regarding a case filed in 2021. The case involves alleged violations of Covid-19 protocols during an assembly byelection campaign in Nalgonda district. Reddy was booked at the Peddavoora police station during the Nagarjuna Sagar bypoll.

articles.headline: ED Probes ₹20.7 Lakh Trail to Retired Official in Land Case
articles.summary: The Enforcement Directorate is investigating payments totaling ₹20.7 lakh from a stone-crushing firm to the wife of a retired Punjab official. The probe concerns the illegal transfer of 92 acres of common land near the Pakistan border in Pathankot. The ED has seized ₹1.75 crore in cash and frozen heavy machinery suspected of being used for illegal mining in the sensitive border zone.

articles.headline: TN Chief Minister Joseph Vijay Warns Party Against Toppling Bid
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay has cautioned his TVK party MLAs to guard against potential toppling bids as the six-month immunity against no-confidence motions ends. With a narrow majority, the ruling front suspects the opposition DMK and AIADMK of plotting to woo inexperienced legislators. Vijay has urged his members to maintain vigilance amid recovery efforts by rival parties.

articles.headline: Bhojpuri Chhath Songs at Mumbai Stations Spark Political Controversy
articles.summary: A decision to play Bhojpuri Chhath Puja songs at Mumbai railway stations has triggered a row between the Railways and local political parties. Shiv Sena (UBT) and MNS leaders argue the move encroaches on Maharashtrian culture and question why local state songs are not prioritized. The dispute highlights regional cultural friction during the festival season.

articles.headline: IT Ministry Reviews Gig Platforms Recording Video for AI Training
articles.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and IT met with platforms like Pronto and Snabbitt to discuss the collection of video data from gig workers for training physical AI models. Officials raised concerns regarding worker consent, consumer privacy, and data sovereignty. Startups argued India should focus on building domestic AI capabilities rather than supplying data to overseas developers.

articles.headline: US Political Shifts May Drive AI Data Center Investment to India
articles.summary: Recent US midterm election results have created uncertainty over AI infrastructure buildouts, potentially prompting developers to consider India as an alternative. Potential US moratoriums on data centers are leading investors to look toward India’s tech-friendly workforce and stable policy environment. Experts suggest India is well-positioned for hyperscalers scaling AI infrastructure.

articles.headline: Google Launches Gemini Decision 1 AI Tool for Business Efficiency
articles.summary: Google has introduced the Gemini Decision 1 model, an AI tool that can evaluate 1,000 questions across text, images, and video in a single pass. The API is designed for business tasks such as tool selection, policy checking, and query routing. The launch marks Google’s latest expansion in providing cost-efficient and faster AI decision-making tools for developers.

articles.headline: UK Regulator Ofcom Fines Meta for Inaccurate WhatsApp Business Data
articles.summary: Meta has been fined $596,565 by British regulator Ofcom for providing inaccurate information during a telecoms market review. Ofcom stated that Meta repeatedly provided incorrect data regarding WhatsApp Business messaging volumes and revenues. The fine follows a 2025 review of the business bulk SMS market intended to understand available services for enterprises.

articles.headline: NPCI Scheme Uses Merchant Fees to Incentivize Small Shop UPI
articles.summary: The NPCI has notified a three-year scheme to use 5% of UPI merchant discount rate income to incentivize banks to bring small shops onto the network. The scheme covers merchants with a turnover up to ₹40 lakh. It aims to boost transaction volumes among small retailers once the 0.4% MDR on payments above ₹2,000 takes effect.

articles.headline: Social Media Firms Seek Alignment of Child Safety and DPDP Rules
articles.summary: Social media platforms have urged the NCPCR to harmonize proposed child safety guidelines with the existing Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) framework. Firms like Google and Meta argued against parallel age-assurance obligations, suggesting that mechanisms for parental consent and data protection should be consistent with the established DPDP regime.

articles.headline: EU Court Adviser Recommends Upholding $1.7 Billion Fine Against Google
articles.summary: An adviser to Europe’s top court has recommended that a €1.49 billion ($1.7 billion) antitrust fine against Google should be upheld. The recommendation challenges a previous lower tribunal decision that scrapped the fine. The penalty relates to anti-competitive practices involving Google's AdSense platform and clauses that restricted rival advertisements.

articles.headline: Anthropic IPO Could Create Thousands of Millionaires Among Employees
articles.summary: AI company Anthropic is preparing for an IPO with a potential valuation of up to $1.41 trillion, which could create over 4,200 employee millionaires. Co-founders could see their paper wealth double to nearly $29 billion each. The debut is expected to be one of the largest wealth events in the technology industry, significantly impacting the private equity and startup landscape.

articles.headline: Mars Targets India Growth Following $36 Billion Kellanova Acquisition
articles.summary: Mars CFO Claus Aagaard stated that the company's India business is expected to more than double after acquiring Kellanova. The deal adds Pringles and Kellogg’s to a portfolio that includes Snickers and Pedigree. Mars is leveraging Kellanova’s distribution reach and tapping into India's growing demand for premium snacks and packaged pet food.

articles.headline: Advent International Shortlists Bidders for ₹5,000 Crore DFM Foods Sale
articles.summary: Private equity firm Advent International has shortlisted Partners Group, ChrysCapital, and EQT Group as potential buyers for its 96.83% stake in Crax maker DFM Foods. The deal is expected to be valued at ₹4,500–5,000 crore. Advent previously delisted the firm in 2023. Strategic interest from firms like ITC and Marico has cooled due to high valuation expectations.

articles.headline: Consumer Goods Makers Increase Stocking as Early Winter Boosts Demand
articles.summary: Firms like Dabur, Emami, and Lux Industries have increased retail stocking by 7-10% due to an early onset of winter in North India. Demand is rising forHealthcare supplements, thermals, and water heaters. Retailers are building inventory early to capitalize on the season, which has been shortened by a late festive window and upcoming wedding season.

articles.headline: Exceptional Items and Subscriber Losses Widen Vodafone Idea’s Q2 Loss
articles.summary: Vodafone Idea reported a consolidated net loss of ₹5,975 crore for the September quarter, widened by exceptional charges related to assets from Vodafone Group UK. Revenue rose 1.7% sequentially to ₹11,884 crore, but the company lost 1.3 million subscribers. The firm is currently in talks to secure additional funding to sustain network expansion and investments.

articles.headline: Oberoi Group Flagship EIH Reports 21 Percent Rise in Net Profit
articles.summary: EIH Ltd, which operates the Oberoi Group hotel chain, reported a 21.4% increase in consolidated net profit to ₹141.5 crore for the September quarter. Revenue from operations rose to ₹694.2 crore, up from ₹597.9 crore in the previous year. The growth reflects a strong recovery and increased occupancy across its luxury hotel portfolio.

articles.headline: New Alcohol Taxation System in Karnataka Reduces Consumption Volumes
articles.summary: Karnataka's shift to a tax system based on alcohol content has led to a 2.4% drop in per capita alcohol consumption over five months. While state tax collections rose 13.4%, consumers moved away from high-strength liquor toward lower-alcohol beer and wine. Per capita consumption of Indian-made foreign liquor fell as consumers reacted to the new pricing structure.

articles.headline: CleanMax to Invest ₹50,000 Crore in Andhra Pradesh Green Projects
articles.summary: CleanMax will invest ₹50,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh for a 2 GW AI compute facility in Kurnool and a 6 GW wind, solar, and storage project. The AI facility is a partnership with Neysa. The company plans to move power-hungry compute factories closer to renewable energy sources. The projects are expected to generate 1,000 direct and 1,000 indirect jobs.

articles.headline: SLN Coffee Plans ₹3,500 Crore Investment in Andhra Pradesh Unit
articles.summary: SLN Coffee Private Limited, maker of the Levista brand, will invest ₹3,500 crore in a new food processing unit in Andhra Pradesh. This marks the company’s first manufacturing facility outside Karnataka. The project is expected to create 3,400 jobs following a memorandum of understanding signed at the CII Partnership Summit.

articles.headline: Global Bond Yields Rise to Decades-High Amid Inflation and Borrowing Fears
articles.summary: Sovereign debt sell-offs have pushed 10-year bond yields to multi-year highs across major economies. The US 10-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2002, while Japanese yields reached levels last seen in 1996. Higher government borrowing and sticky inflation are driving the repricing. India's benchmark 10-year yield reached a four-year high of 7.50% in October.

articles.headline: Domestic Institutional Investors Book Profits as FPIs Inflow ₹75,000 Crore
articles.summary: Domestic institutional investors sold equities worth over ₹47,662 crore in the past fortnight, marking their longest selling streak in four years. The selling occurred as foreign portfolio investors pumped over ₹75,000 crore into Indian markets in November. Benchmarks Sensex and Nifty stretched their winning runs, even as domestic funds trimmed exposure to richly valued stocks.

articles.headline: Banks Seek Centralized Framework for Small-Value Fraud Claim Settlements
articles.summary: Indian banks have requested a standardized industry-level framework for reporting and settling claims for small-value fraudulent electronic transactions. This follows an RBI policy providing compensation up to ₹25,000 for victims starting January 2027. Banks are seeking clarity on customer eligibility, reporting timelines, and beneficiary bank liability to ensure coordinated implementation.

articles.headline: Moody’s Warns AI Poses Displacement Risks to India’s IT Sector
articles.summary: Moody’s Ratings reported that while AI could boost productivity, it creates job displacement risks for emerging markets with high IT and outsourcing exposure, such as India. The report also highlighted rising debt in India and China due to interest expenses. Moody’s forecast India's real GDP growth at 7% for both 2026 and 2027, with inflation projected at 4.5%.

articles.headline: Road Ministry Doubles Performance Security for Bridge Health Sensors
articles.summary: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has raised the performance security for national highway bridge sensor contracts to 10% of the value. The increase from 5% is intended to ensure high safety standards for real-time bridge health monitoring. The decision follows recent bridge collapse incidents and applies to national and centrally sponsored road works.

articles.headline: Ministry Proposes Reducing Minimum Fleet for Car Hire Businesses
articles.summary: The road transport ministry has proposed reducing the minimum fleet requirement for car hire businesses from 50 vehicles to five. The relaxation aims to encourage startups and small local operators to enter the market for self-drive and chauffeur-driven rentals. The move is expected to allow existing operators to expand into new locations more easily.

articles.headline: Kidambi Srikanth and Lakshya Sen Reach Kumamoto Masters Quarterfinals
articles.summary: Indian shuttlers Kidambi Srikanth and Lakshya Sen progressed to the men’s singles quarterfinals at the Kumamoto Masters Japan. Srikanth defeated Ng Tze Yong in three games, while Sen secured a straight-games win over China's Dong Tian Yao. Sen will face Japan’s Yushi Tanaka, while Srikanth is set to play Koki Watanabe in the next round.

articles.headline: Vivaan Kapoor Wins Shooting Silver and Secures 2028 Olympics Quota
articles.summary: India's Vivaan Kapoor won the silver medal in the men's trap event at the ISSF World Championships in Doha. The podium finish also earned India a quota place for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Kapoor narrowly missed the world title in a competitive final, marking a significant achievement for Indian shooting on the global stage.

articles.headline: Kennedy Family Sues to Block Trump's Triumphal Arch in Arlington
articles.summary: Descendants of John F. Kennedy have filed a lawsuit to block a 250-foot triumphal arch planned by Donald Trump near Arlington National Cemetery. The family argues the structure would cast permanent shadows on Kennedy's eternal flame and memorial. A federal judge has temporarily blocked construction while the court considers challenges to the project's legality.

articles.headline: Microscopic World Revealed on Rembrandt's Iconic Painting The Night Watch
articles.summary: A joint exhibition by Rijksmuseum and Artis-Micropia has revealed the hidden world of microbes covering Rembrandt's 'Night Watch.' Researchers found common skin and soil bacteria, plus a rare Japanese bacteria, on the masterpiece. The study is part of 'Operation Night Watch,' a large-scale restoration project intended to spark curiosity about the microscopic universe.

articles.headline: King Charles and Elton John Celebrate 50 Years of King’s Trust
articles.summary: Britain’s King Charles joined Elton John for a special radio episode to mark the 50th anniversary of the King’s Trust. The charity, founded by Charles in 1976, has supported over a million young people in finding jobs or starting businesses. The episode will air on Charles’s 78th birthday, highlighting the role of music in the charity’s history.

articles.headline: Rare Pink Diamond and Romanov Sapphire Lead Geneva Jewellery Auctions
articles.summary: Geneva's seasonal auctions featured a 24-carat pink diamond from the Golconda mines, which sold for $14.6 million at Christie’s. Sotheby’s auctioned a 198-carat vivid blue Ceylon sapphire associated with Russia’s Romanov dynasty. The sapphire, mounted in a diamond bracelet by Cartier, was estimated at up to $2 million, highlighting a strong market for historical royal heirlooms.

articles.headline: China Boycotts Spanish Football After Mbappé Mao Zedong Meme Row
articles.summary: Chinese broadcasters stopped airing La Liga matches after Real Madrid striker Kylian Mbappé mocked an internet meme comparing him to Mao Zedong. Mbappé's comments calling Mao a 'dictator' caused massive backlash and lost sponsorships. Despite apologies from the player and the league, experts warn of serious damage to commercial interests in the world's second-largest economy.

articles.headline: Antoine Arnault Elected President of Paris FC Following Majority Stake Acquisition
articles.summary: Antoine Arnault, son of billionaire Bernard Arnault, has been elected president of Paris FC. The appointment follows the acquisition of a majority stake in the French club by Agache Sport and Red Bull. Arnault succeeds Pierre Ferracci and aims to lead the club’s development in Ligue 1. Arnault is also the CEO of Christian Dior and vice-chairman of the LVMH conglomerate.

articles.headline: Historical Review Recalls Laika the First Dog to Orbit Earth
articles.summary: A historical feature marks the legacy of Laika, the first dog in space, launched aboard Sputnik 2 in 1957. Records revealed in 1991 confirmed Laika died from overheating hours into the flight, contrary to initial Soviet claims of her surviving days. The mission, which had no reentry plan, became a foundational event for the global animal rights movement.

articles.headline: Harry Styles Criticizes Astronomical Ten Dollar Coffee Prices in New York
articles.summary: Singer Harry Styles expressed frustration over coffee prices in New York City, noting a cappuccino costs $10. Speaking during a concert, Styles also criticized the city's tipping culture, which often reaches 24%. His remarks sparked debate among fans about the rising cost of living, even as some pointed to Styles' own high-earning celebrity lifestyle.

articles.headline: Court Convicts Two Men in South African President's Farm Theft
articles.summary: A South African court found two men guilty of a 2020 burglary at President Cyril Ramaphosa's Phala Phala farmhouse. The heist involved at least $580,000 hidden in furniture, which Ramaphosa claimed was revenue from buffalo sales. The scandal nearly led to his impeachment after allegations suggested the stolen amount was much higher and had been concealed.

articles.headline: Rajasthan draft electoral rolls show 11 lakh more voters
articles.summary: The draft electoral rolls for Rajasthan under the Special Summary Revision 2027 show 5.26 crore voters, approximately 11 lakh more than the final Special Intensive Revision published in February. The count includes 2.75 crore male and 2.51 crore female voters. Officials noted variations between different official lists as the verification of names continues through the claim window.

articles.headline: Government signals special Parliament session for women’s quota and seat increase
articles.summary: The BJP-led government indicated a likely short Parliament session to take up the bill for implementing women’s reservation from 2029. The proposal includes increasing Lok Sabha seats by nearly 50%. A senior official claimed the governing alliance would secure the necessary two-thirds majority for the constitutional amendment, potentially gaining support from 15-18 additional MPs.

articles.headline: Delhi air quality nears severe category as smog blankets city
articles.summary: Delhi's Air Quality Index (AQI) deteriorated to 387 on Thursday night, the highest of the season. At least 18 monitoring stations recorded 'severe' levels above 400, with IIT-Delhi peaking at 466. Sources of pollution included waste burning, paddy residue, and organic aerosols. Weather experts predict the air quality will remain in the 'very poor' category for the next two days.

articles.headline: Karnataka Congress plans to restore anti-conversion law to original form
articles.summary: Karnataka Congress chief B.K. Hariprasad announced the state government's intent to rollback 2022 amendments made to the anti-conversion law by the previous BJP government. Minority and Dalit groups staged protests in Bengaluru demanding the repeal of both anti-conversion and anti-cattle slaughter laws, arguing they infringe on religious freedom and livelihoods.

articles.headline: Ola fined 10 lakh for misleading 'tip to ride' app prompts
articles.summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority imposed a penalty of Rs 10 lakh on Ola for using 'dark patterns' to nudge consumers into paying additional fares. The app suggested that tipping might increase the chances of getting a ride faster. The authority ruled that the platform failed to prove that tipping did not influence ride allocation and ordered the removal of such prompts.

articles.headline: Sunil Mittal's OneWeb to replace ageing satellites with multi-billion investment
articles.summary: Eutelsat OneWeb will begin replacing its low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites next week as many reach the end of their 7-8 year life cycle. Sunil Bharti Mittal stated the company would refresh the constellation with an investment of several billion dollars. In India, the satcom service is intended to provide complementary coverage for areas lacking fiber connectivity, such as oil rigs and farms.

articles.headline: Over 9 lakh Indians acquired OECD citizenships in five years
articles.summary: Approximately 9.25 lakh Indian citizens acquired the nationality of OECD member countries between 2020 and 2024, representing a 41% increase from the previous five-year period. Canada remains the top destination, followed by the US and Australia. India continues to be the largest country of former nationality among those acquiring citizenship in advanced economies.

articles.headline: Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first Black senator in 150 years
articles.summary: Democrat Scott Colom, a civil rights attorney, defeated Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith by a narrow margin of 4,600 votes to become Mississippi’s first Black US senator since the Reconstruction era. Colom's campaign focused on local economic issues, such as food prices. The victory is significant in a state with the highest proportion of Black residents in the United States.

articles.headline: Two dead and six injured in Delhi auto-dumper collision
articles.summary: A dumper truck collided with an autorickshaw carrying eight passengers in Delhi's Sonia Vihar, killing the driver and one passenger. A six-month pregnant woman passenger suffered a miscarriage, and a six-month-old girl was among the six injured. Police have registered a case for rash driving and negligence and are searching for the truck driver who fled the scene.

articles.headline: Vasant Kunj car crash kills 22-year-old driving at 202 kmph
articles.summary: A 22-year-old man died after his car, traveling at 202 kmph, crashed into a wall and caught fire in southwest Delhi’s Vasant Kunj. Police found a social media post uploaded by the victim just before the accident showing the vehicle's high speed. The driver was returning from Ludhiana to Gurgaon when he lost control of the vehicle. No other passengers were involved.

articles.headline: Chanakya Rail Enclave named NDMC's 10th Anupam Colony
articles.summary: The New Delhi Municipal Council designated Chanakya Rail Enclave as its 10th 'Anupam Colony' for achieving 100% waste segregation. The initiative, launched in 2025, encourages source segregation and composting by residents. NDMC aims to develop five more such colonies soon. Earlier recognized areas include Chanakyapuri, Jor Bagh, and Golf Links.

articles.headline: Delhi students develop low-cost air filter for classroom fans
articles.summary: Two Delhi teenagers have developed 'Project Vayu,' a slip-on air filter for table and wall fans costing just Rs 140. Tests showed the filter could reduce PM2.5 levels by up to 90% in a closed 200 sq ft room over several hours. The project aims to provide affordable air purification for schools that cannot afford expensive commercial purifiers. Over 295 classrooms have been involved in pilots.

articles.headline: High Court rules earning daughters eligible for motor accident compensation
articles.summary: Delhi High Court observed that married or earning family members cannot be denied motor accident compensation solely due to lack of financial dependency. The court increased compensation for a woman whose father and sister died in a 2015 crash, stating that legal representatives can maintain claims based on the 'loss of estate' regardless of their separate residence or employment status.

articles.headline: Political parties compete for Poorvanchali votes through Chhath Puja events
articles.summary: Chhath Puja in Delhi has evolved into a major political event as parties vie for the support of the Poorvanchali community, which makes up over 30% of the electorate. Activities included a river cruise launch by the CM and a Yamuna dip by a BJP MP. The festival serves as an annual audit of the Yamuna's water quality, with political messaging tied to the river's cleaning progress.

articles.headline: DPCC fails to recover 50 crore in environmental penalties
articles.summary: An RTI disclosure revealed that the Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC) has recovered only Rs 3 lakh out of nearly Rs 49.7 crore in environmental compensation imposed on sewage and effluent treatment plants over six years. Experts say the lack of financial accountability defeats the purpose of penalties, as most treatment plants continue to fail environmental norms.

articles.headline: Bhalswa landfill flattening deadline pushed to April 2027
articles.summary: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has set a new deadline of April 2027 to clear the Bhalswa landfill, marking the seventh extension for the project. Approximately 21 lakh metric tonnes of legacy waste remain at the site. MCD officials cited the transition between contractors and the continuous dumping of fresh waste as reasons for the delay in reclaiming the land.

articles.headline: Court acquits 2020 Delhi riots accused over faulty CCTV certification
articles.summary: A Delhi court acquitted all surviving accused in a 2020 riots case, citing the police's failure to produce valid certificates for electronic evidence as required by the Indian Evidence Act. The judge directed the Police Commissioner to ensure investigators are properly trained in authenticating CCTV footage, noting that shortcomings in digital evidence often lead to the collapse of cases.

articles.headline: Woman loses arm in Vasai after confronting molester on train
articles.summary: A 20-year-old woman lost her left arm under a moving train at Naigaon station after a 53-year-old man pushed her onto the tracks. The victim had confronted the man for molesting her inside a coach. Police arrested the suspect, who has been charged with molestation and attempt to murder. The victim is currently undergoing treatment at a Mumbai hospital.

articles.headline: India-Bangladesh consular dialogue postponed amid strained bilateral ties
articles.summary: The fifth India-Bangladesh consular dialogue, originally scheduled for November 17-18 in Dhaka, has been postponed. The talks were expected to cover visa processes, border management, and the repatriation of detained citizens. The delay indicates a stall in bilateral mechanisms following recent political shifts and ongoing tensions between the two neighboring countries.

articles.headline: Ex-Naxal chief Deoji demands release of 7,000 Maoists from jail
articles.summary: Surrendered top CPI (Maoist) leader Thippiri Thirupathi, alias Deoji, has called for the government to lift the ban on the outfit and release up to 7,000 imprisoned members. Currently studying law, Deoji expressed intent to lead the organization into democratic, legal politics. He argued that the political document of the group must adapt to achieve an exploitation-free society through law.

articles.headline: AAP drops seven sitting MLAs in second Punjab poll list
articles.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party released its second list of 31 candidates for the Punjab assembly elections, axing seven sitting MLAs, including Agriculture Minister Gurmeet Singh Khudian. The list features two sitting MPs and five women. The party has now announced 71 candidates in total, aiming to gain an early advantage by allowing candidates more time to campaign in their constituencies.

articles.headline: Railways reviews removal of RAC facility to improve passenger comfort
articles.summary: The Indian Railways is considering the abolition of the Reservation Against Cancellation (RAC) system, where two passengers share a single berth. The move follows concerns that charging full fare for half a sleeping space is inappropriate. A parliamentary panel had previously recommended reviewing the arrangement to ensure passenger convenience and fair pricing.

articles.headline: FDA warns of potential vision loss from GLP-1 weight-loss drugs
articles.summary: The US health regulator has directed manufacturers of GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic and Wegovy to include warnings about NAION, a rare eye condition that can cause permanent blindness. Clinical trials showed a slightly higher risk for users compared to those on other medications. Experts advise patients to monitor for sudden, painless vision loss and maintain blood sugar control.

articles.headline: Kia to invest 2 billion dollars in second Andhra Pradesh plant
articles.summary: Kia and its suppliers will invest $2 billion to establish a second manufacturing plant in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh. The facility, expected to start production in 2030, will add an annual capacity of 2 lakh vehicles, focusing on both electric and combustion-engine models. The project is projected to create approximately 12,000 direct and indirect jobs in the region.

articles.headline: Niti Aayog report says PLI schemes drew 2.4 lakh crore investment
articles.summary: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes have facilitated investments worth Rs 2.4 lakh crore as of March 2026, reaching 76% of the target. A study by Niti Aayog found the schemes boosted exports by Rs 15.2 lakh crore and generated 14 lakh jobs. Sectors like electronics, pharmaceuticals, and solar modules showed the strongest performance, though some import dependencies remain.

articles.headline: Eight killed in Brooklyn apartment building collapse
articles.summary: A three-story apartment building in Brooklyn, New York, collapsed, killing eight people and injuring 17 others, including three firefighters. The building collapsed during construction work on an adjoining lot, leading to a city-issued stop-work order. Emergency crews worked through the night to search for survivors trapped in the rubble of the structure.

articles.headline: PT Usha returns to IOA fray as ice hockey nominee
articles.summary: PT Usha has entered the Indian Olympic Association (IOA) Executive Council race as a nominee for the Ice Hockey Association of India. This follows her earlier loss in the Sportspersons of Outstanding Merit elections. The move allows her to continue her bid for a second term as IOA president. The Executive Council elections are scheduled to take place on December 5.

articles.headline: Anirudh Ravichander and Kaviya Maran marry in Greece
articles.summary: Music composer Anirudh Ravichander and SunRisers Hyderabad CEO Kaviya Maran tied the knot in an intimate ceremony in Greece on November 11. The wedding was attended by family and close friends, including Rajinikanth and former Tamil Nadu CM M.K. Stalin. The couple plans to host a wedding reception in Chennai on November 21 for industry peers and dignitaries.

articles.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo to star in football drama series Day 1s
articles.summary: Football legend Cristiano Ronaldo is set to executive produce and appear in a new British TV drama titled 'Day 1s'. The series explores the high-stakes world of player management and features actor Damian Lewis as a fictional football agent. Production has recently begun on the project, which aims to provide a behind-the-scenes look at the business side of the sport.

articles.headline: LTCG tax filers surge, but still a tiny minority
articles.summary: Only about 5% of individual tax filers declare Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG). The number of individuals filing LTCG returns rose from 0.75 million in AY20 to 3.8 million in AY24. Industry bodies seek LTCG rationalisation.

articles.headline: Payments journey is beginning to take off: Meta India head
articles.summary: Meta India head Arun Srinivas highlighted WhatsApp Pay's strategic importance, expansion in payments, business interactions, and AI adoption by small businesses as key drivers. WhatsApp Pay is integrating bill payments across 30 categories.

articles.headline: RIL to invest ~43K cr in Andhra underground coal gasification project
articles.summary: Reliance Industries signed an MoU with Andhra Pradesh to invest ~43,000 crore in an underground coal gasification project over two years, with a potential overall investment of ~2.7 trillion in three phases.

articles.headline: Amaravati quantum computing facility to be operational in Feb
articles.summary: South Asia's first quantum computing manufacturing facility will be established in Amaravati, operational by February 3, 2027. It includes a 2 GW compute factory and aims to attract global investors.

articles.headline: Andhra nets ~5.8 trillion on Day 1
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh secured MoUs and preliminary deals worth ~5.84 trillion on the first day of the CII Partnership Summit, with potential to create over 107,000 jobs.

articles.headline: Crude oil retreat may offer India macroeconomic relief
articles.summary: Falling crude oil prices below $90 a barrel could bring macroeconomic relief to India by easing inflation, narrowing the current account deficit, and limiting strain on government finances.

articles.headline: CAG to launch in-house LLM for auditors
articles.summary: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) will launch an in-house large language model (LLM) to enhance audit planning and execution by analyzing data from internal inspection reports and multiple departments.

articles.headline: India to have one of the ‘best’ trade deals with the US: Goyal
articles.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated India will have one of the "best" trade deals with the US, achieving very good outcomes in all respects.

articles.headline: Farm work’s gender skew widens in 14 of 20 states
articles.summary: The gap between rural women and men employed in agriculture widened in 14 of 20 states, as more men moved into non-farm occupations, increasing the gender divide in farm employment.

articles.headline: Nvidia CEO Huang’s exit jolts tech world
articles.summary: Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO raises concerns about the company's continued support for the AI boom and its role in financing AI startups and data centers.

articles.headline: Page Industries shares plunge over 12% as margins contract
articles.summary: Page Industries shares dropped over 12% as margins contracted in Q2FY27, despite a 4% rise in net profit and 11.5% revenue growth.

articles.headline: StanChart brings four Signature CIO Funds from GIFT City
articles.summary: Standard Chartered launched four Signature CIO Funds from GIFT City, offering diversified multi-asset portfolios investing across global equities, bonds, commodities, and alternatives.

articles.headline: Strong demand, valuations positive for Tata Power
articles.summary: Tata Power's Q2FY27 revenue met estimates, though operating profit was below consensus. Demand remains strong, with RE capacity expansion guiding future growth.

articles.headline: BSE changes methodology for hold Niveshak Shivir in Delhi
articles.summary: BSE announced a rejig of six sector indices and will co-host a Niveshak Shivir with Sebi and IEPFA in Delhi to resolve pending claims.

articles.headline: Samil adds new wheels to its growth engine
articles.summary: Samil reported mixed Q2FY27 results with strong revenue growth offset by margin pressure. The company aims to expand non-auto businesses and gain market share through acquisitions.

articles.headline: Seeking assured returns? These savings options offer up to 8.2%
articles.summary: Several savings options, including NSC, SCSS, RBI bonds, and bank FDs, offer interest rates of 7.5% or more, providing assured returns without stock market exposure.

articles.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO amid extramarital affair scandal
articles.summary: Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia in 1993, resigned as CEO following revelations of extramarital affairs with a company associate and a businesswoman suspected of being a Chinese spy. The company's market value dropped by $300 billion after the announcement. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress has been named interim CEO while the board conducts a search for a permanent successor.

articles.headline: Bodhi Tree acquires majority stake in A2B for $180 million
articles.summary: Investment firm Bodhi Tree Systems has acquired a majority stake in the restaurant and snack shop chain Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) for $180 million. The deal provides an exit to existing investors including Lyca Systems and Sahayog. A2B currently operates over 160 stores across India and international markets. The investment aims to help the brand scale globally using modern tech.

articles.headline: Reliance and Waaree among bidders for 10GWh battery storage PLI
articles.summary: The Indian government has shortlisted 22 bidders, including Reliance Industries and Waaree Energies, for the ₹3,620 crore production-linked incentive (PLI) scheme for battery energy storage systems (BESS). The scheme aims to create 10GWh of domestic manufacturing capacity. Selected firms must set up units by 2026-27 to support India's growing renewable energy infrastructure.

articles.headline: PM Modi to attend Asean and East Asia summits in Manila
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will travel to the Philippines next week for the Asean-India and East Asia summits. Discussions are expected to focus on India's 'Act East' policy and the Indo-Pacific vision. A potential Quad leaders' meeting on the sidelines remains tentative. The visit comes amid regional tensions regarding maritime law and rights in the South China Sea.

articles.headline: MSCI adds four Indian companies to its global standard index
articles.summary: Index provider MSCI has added four Indian firms—Adani Green Energy, Coforge, Life Insurance Corp of India, and Mankind Pharma—to its flagship Global Standard Index. The move is expected to attract significant foreign passive inflows into these stocks. Consequently, India's weight in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index is projected to rise to a new record high of approximately 13.15%.

articles.headline: Zee Entertainment announces ₹600 crore share buyback plan
articles.summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd has approved a share buyback worth ₹600 crore at a 24% premium over its current market price. The move is intended to restore investor confidence following recent earnings volatility. The company will buy back shares at ₹173.50 per unit. Promoter groups, including the Goenka family, have stated they will not participate in the buyback program.

articles.headline: Rupee hits one-week low as it slips past 94 per dollar
articles.summary: The Indian rupee weakened 35 paise to close at a one-week low of 94.04 against the US dollar. The decline was fueled by high dollar demand from importers and general strength in the greenback. Market analysts noted that the currency surrendered early gains amid bargain buying by state-owned banks, with resistance levels now expected around the 94.30 mark.

articles.headline: India's retail inflation breaches RBI tolerance limit at 6.09 percent
articles.summary: Consumer Price Index (CPI) based inflation rose to 6.09% in October from 5.5% in September, exceeding the RBI's 6% tolerance threshold for the first time in two years. The spike was driven by food inflation hitting 8.9%, with onion prices rising 116%. Economists suggest the Monetary Policy Committee may consider an interest rate hike during its December meeting to curb rising costs.

articles.headline: Ola Electric narrows losses to ₹362 crore despite lower deliveries
articles.summary: EV manufacturer Ola Electric reported a narrowed net loss of ₹362 crore for Q2 FY27, down 13% year-on-year. Revenue fell 39% to ₹421 crore as deliveries dropped to 34,667 vehicles from over 52,000 a year ago. The company is transitioning to a dealer-led distribution model, having already expanded to 255 dealer partners operating 319 stores.

articles.headline: Kia India and Suppliers to Invest $2 Billion in Andhra Pradesh
articles.summary: Kia India will invest $2 billion along with its supplier partners to establish its second manufacturing plant in Andhra Pradesh. The facility will have an annual capacity of 200,000 units, taking Kia’s total combined capacity in India to over 600,000 units. The expansion is intended to meet expected sales growth in the domestic market and meet overseas export demand.

articles.headline: ReNew Energy to invest ₹80,000 crore in Andhra green complex
articles.summary: ReNew Energy Global Plc will invest ₹80,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh for a massive digital and clean energy manufacturing complex. The project includes a 1-GW green hyperscale data centre in Anakapalli and metallurgical silicon facilities. The company also plans to establish a Centre for Technical Excellence to train youth in renewable energy and advanced manufacturing skills.

articles.headline: OpenAI launches local API processing and inference in India
articles.summary: OpenAI has announced local processing and inference for its API in India, starting with the GPT-6 Luna model. This allows Indian businesses to process AI requests within the country, addressing data residency requirements. The move is expected to help more organizations adopt AI for sensitive workloads where in-country information processing is a deciding factor.

articles.headline: Home Minister Amit Shah reviews Delhi policing and organised crime
articles.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired a security review meeting at the Delhi Police headquarters to discuss crime control and festive season arrangements. The meeting focused on curbing organised crime, drug trafficking, and enhancing women's safety. Discussions also covered crowd management strategies for the upcoming festivals and more effective policing responses in the capital.

articles.headline: Two missing SPOs found dead in Jammu and Kashmir forest
articles.summary: The bodies of Special Police Officers Rashpal Kumar and Bobby Chand were found with bullet wounds in the Kishtwar district forest. Their service rifles were missing. The officers went missing on November 10 while traveling to an Army post. Security forces have launched a search for the attackers amid concerns of a potential revival of terrorism in the Chenab Valley region.

articles.headline: Manchester United sacks Michael Carrick after brief tenure
articles.summary: Manchester United has sacked Michael Carrick as manager after only ten months in the role, following the club's drop into the Premier League relegation zone. Mauricio Pochettino is reportedly finalizing a deal to take over as the permanent boss. Fans have expressed growing frustration with the club's ownership as United seeks its seventh permanent manager since 2013.

articles.headline: Shreyas Iyer to Make ODI Captaincy Debut Against New Zealand
articles.summary: Shreyas Iyer will lead India in the final two ODIs against New Zealand as the teambalances white-ball goals with Test preparations. India leads the series 2-0. Major squad changes see Shubman Gill and KL Rahul leaving for Test duty, offering opportunities for Ruturaj Gaikwad and Ishan Kishan. New Zealand must win the remaining matches to level the five-match series.

articles.headline: Trump directs Vice President Vance to focus on urban crime
articles.summary: President Donald Trump has directed Vice President JD Vance to pivot his focus from Iran peace negotiations to addressing crime and corruption in Democratic-run cities. Trump stated that the U.S. does not currently need a deal with Iran. The move follows reports that Vance had been considering face-to-face talks with Iranian security officials to resolve ongoing conflicts.

articles.headline: Oct SIP openings at 18-mth low, closures highest since April ’25
articles.summary: Mutual fund SIP account registrations fell to an 18-month low of 5.1 million in October, while closures rose to 5.9 million, the highest since April 2025. Active SIP accounts declined to 108 million from 108.9 million in September. Monthly SIP contributions also fell to ~32,160 crore from ~32,490 crore.

articles.headline: Vi’s loss widened to ~5,975 cr in Q2; co raises additional ~4K cr
articles.summary: Vodafone Idea's losses widened to ~5,975 crore in Q2FY27, up from ~5,524 crore in Q2FY26, due to an exceptional loss. Revenue grew 6% to ~11,884 crore. The company raised ~4,000 crore in Q2FY27, adding to ~6,400 crore raised in Q1FY27.

articles.headline: Only 28% of PLI employment target met by FY26
articles.summary: India's Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes have achieved only 28% of their targeted employment generation by FY26, though investment mobilization reached 76%. NITI Aayog called for sector-specific interventions and a shift towards demand-side support.

articles.headline: Oct retail inflation crossed 6%, first time in 2 years
articles.summary: India's retail inflation (CPI) rose to a two-year high of 6.09% in October, exceeding the RBI's 6% limit. Food prices and broad-based increases across 11 of 12 divisions pushed inflation up from 5.54% in September.

articles.headline: Oil India PAT zooms 53% to ~2,521 cr on higher price realisation
articles.summary: Oil India reported a 53% jump in PAT to ~2,521 crore in Q2FY27, driven by a 20% increase in crude oil production and a 35% rise in crude oil price realization.

articles.headline: New biz margins up for life insurers
articles.summary: Most listed life insurers improved VNB margins in H1FY27 due to a shift towards protection, traditional savings, and annuity products, despite Ulip share moderation at some firms.

articles.headline: Banks raise deposit rates after Oct repo rate hike
articles.summary: Major lenders have raised interest rates on select fixed deposit tenures following the RBI's 25 bps repo rate hike in October, with some FD rates reaching up to 7.50% for senior citizens.

articles.headline: India Inc’s ECB, FCCB fundraising intent falls to $7 billion in Sep
articles.summary: Indian companies filed proposals to raise $7.05 billion through ECBs and FCCBs in September, a decrease from $8.13 billion in August, according to RBI data.

articles.headline: Karnataka banks on local talent and frontier tech for GIM 2027
articles.summary: Karnataka unveiled its Global Investors Meet 2027 theme 'Powering what’s Next', focusing on frontier technology, engineering, talent, sustainability, and partnerships. Bengaluru is a chip design hub and AI cluster.

articles.headline: Take the ‘India story’ to the world: PM to media
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged the media to spotlight India's achievements, talent, and transformations globally, terming them the 'India Story'. He highlighted poverty removal and economic progress.

articles.headline: No clarity on Quad meeting in Manila: MEA
articles.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs stated that a Quad Summit meeting in Manila remains uncertain, with PM Modi attending the East Asia Summit and ASEAN Summit.

articles.headline: At COP31, leaders of island countries warn of ‘life-or-death’ crisis
articles.summary: Small island leaders at COP31 called for urgent action on climate change, describing planet heating as a life-or-death issue due to rising seas, extreme weather, and increasing damage.

articles.headline: Israeli airstrike on Gaza hospital kills 6
articles.summary: An Israeli airstrike on southern Gaza's main hospital killed at least six Palestinians, including a surgeon, with Israel accusing militants of using the hospital complex to plan attacks.

articles.headline: US envoys meet Putin as Russia hits Ukraine’s power grid
articles.summary: US envoys met President Putin in Moscow for Ukraine peace talks, while Ukraine warned of renewed restrictions on its air-defense system. Russia continued strikes on Ukraine's power grid.

articles.headline: UK economy grew by most in 30 months
articles.summary: Britain's economy expanded by 0.7% in Q3 2026, the fastest rate in 30 months, aided by artificial intelligence and strong first-half performance.

articles.headline: Xi says Taiwan ‘reunification’ must happen
articles.summary: China's President Xi Jinping stated Taiwan's 'reunification' must happen, urging peaceful means but drawing a firm rebuff from Taipei, which views itself as governed separately.

articles.headline: Investment in coal gasification needs assured demand
articles.summary: The tepid response to the second round of the coal-gasification scheme highlights the gap between policy ambition and commercial viability, requiring long-term purchase agreements and improved logistics.

articles.headline: Need for stronger and effective industrial safety
articles.summary: Recent industrial accidents underscore weak safety practices. Accountability and enforcement across contractor arrangements are crucial for operational continuity and investment confidence.

articles.headline: The real good news: It is the stable rupee, not the blue wave in the US
articles.summary: The rupee's appreciation following RBI's forex measures is attributed to curbing excessive speculation, improving sentiment, and encouraging FII inflows, turning a depreciation spiral into a virtuous cycle.

articles.headline: The delayed promise of green hydrogen
articles.summary: India's National Green Hydrogen Mission faces execution challenges, with high production costs and a lack of demand mandates hindering commercial viability despite significant investment pledges.

articles.headline: Docs caution against sudden withdrawal of GLP-1 drugs
articles.summary: Doctors advise against indiscriminate withdrawal of GLP-1 drugs due to a rare eye condition (NAION) risk, stressing the drugs' significant metabolic and cardiovascular benefits. Labels will be updated.

articles.headline: A frightfully good business as horror looks beyond the screen
articles.summary: HorrorCon India is becoming a significant entertainment property, attracting a diverse audience and brands by fostering a community around horror IP beyond just screen-based content.

articles.headline: TATA TUSSLE: Philanthropy, law not competing objectives: Parsi priest letter to PM
articles.summary: A Parsi high priest wrote to PM Modi expressing concern over the Tata dispute, stating philanthropy and law are not competing objectives. He urged dialogue and restraint, acknowledging Shapoorji Pallonji's community work.
